title: Session log index
description: The index of the session logs: one row per session, newest last, each with its date, its session id and a summary that says whether the log is worth opening. Session logs are the one collection filed by date and session rather than by identifier, so this is their manifest. Named MANIFEST-logs.json.

kind.description: the word logs, which is what chooses this schema

updated.description: the date the index was last brought level with the log files, YYYY-MM-DD

date.description: the day of the session, YYYY-MM-DD

session.description: the eight-character session id, the short form used everywhere in the cockpit

session_id.description: the full session uuid the harness gave

summary.description: what happened, in enough words to decide whether to open the log; a placeholder at session start, replaced at session end
